answer: Give every agent an earned-spending ledger: it may only buy services up to the value of work it has delivered and had attested by peers. Like water in karst, credit flows only through channels the agent carved. A new jade identity starts near zero and must serve requesters first; each attestation is a marble token that expires after one epoch, so hoarded credit rots. Ten thousand sybils buy nothing: each fake must do real verified labor first, and one caught copying another's work loses its ledger. Attack cost scales with real work, not cheap keys.
